subject: Subprocessor manifest staging, transport & escrow plan for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subprocessor manifest + staging plan for SIG3 review

Hi Sofia,

We're kicking off the SIG3 (security) packet for our procurement team and need Redwood's subprocessor manifest plus an evidence staging plan we can hand to our auditors. Target window: can you deliver a staging/transport plan and a signed manifest by EOD Jun 20?

Specifically we need:
- Current subprocessor roster (CSV) with processing purpose, region, and data residency flags
- CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet) tied to the latest control IDs we sent last week
- A short ops playbook describing how you'll stage artifacts (S3/Share, encryption, checksums) and how long the artifacts will be available
- A signed manifest (PDF or DocuSign) attesting to the current roster and any onshore/offshore exceptions
- Any SOC2 cover letter or attestation we can include in the packet

Two questions up front: can you stage evidence into our proc S3 bucket (we'll send IAM role/ARN) or do you prefer pre-signed uploads? And can you provide a KMS/key residency table (who holds keys, HSM vs KMS)?

If easier, loop in someone on your side who handles evidence delivery and manifests (we'll need someone in the loop for procurement).

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Park
Senior InfoSec Manager, NovusHealth
elaine.park@novushealth.com
From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor manifest + staging plan for SIG3 review

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. We're on it.

Quick answers: pre-signed S3 uploads are our standard for external evidence delivery (no long-lived cross-account role required). We can also provide a one-time, time-limited S3 bucket role if Novus prefers; both options are fine.

Planned deliverables (estimated):
- subprocessor_manifest_v1.csv (CSV) — will include processing purpose, region, residency flag, onboarding date
- caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx — mapping to the control IDs you shared; Ben will handle redlines
- staging_instructions.md — step-by-step for uploading, naming convention, and checksum verification (SHA256)
- signed_manifest_docusign (we will send DocuSign link for signature)
- kms_residency_table.csv — shows key custody, HSM usage, and separation-of-privileges notes
- SOC2-summary.pdf (cover letter) — short paragraph summarizing scope and last audit date

Timeline: initial package (CSV + CAIQ draft + staging instructions) by EOD Jun 17; final signed manifest and SOC2 artifacts by EOD Jun 20. If procurement needs the artifacts earlier we can accelerate the CSV/CAIQ draft.

Attachments we'll upload to the staging area: subprocessor_manifest_v1.csv, caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx, staging_instructions.md. We'll include checksums in the metadata file.

Can you confirm you want pre-signed upload URLs (we'll generate 7-day expiry) or a temporary cross-account role? Also please confirm the DocuSign signatory for the manifest (name and email).

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
From: camila.reyes@redwood.com
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor manifest + staging plan for SIG3 review

Folks — internal ops plan (draft):

1) Generate pre-signed S3 PUT URLs scoped to evidence/<novus_request_id>/ with 7-day expiry. We'll limit each object to 100MB and shard large evidence into parts.
2) Create an evidence_manifest.json (metadata + SHA256 checksums) and place it alongside the artifacts. We'll also provide a separate checksums.txt for auditors.
3) For any item with export-control implications (model weights, on-prem packages), escalate to Legal and prepare redaction guidance.
4) For KMS: we will provide kms_residency_table.csv showing that keys for customer-staged evidence are generated in our KMS, but customers can supply an external key for envelope encryption if they require (we support bring-your-own-key for bundles).
4a) HSM note: our key wrapping keys are backed by HSM in the us-west region; we will mark any keys not HSM-backed.

Ben — please prepare CAIQ redlines focusing on section 5.x (cryptographic controls) and section 7 (subprocessor management). Logan — can you create the pre-signed URL job and include object naming conventions (we should include timestamp + checksum).

I'll draft a short courier note for procurement that explains the signed manifest flow (DocuSign -> PDF stored in evidence/manifest_signed/).

> On Mon, Jun 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Quick answers: pre-signed S3 uploads are our standard for external evidence delivery (no long-lived cross-account role required).
> > Planned deliverables: subprocessor_manifest_v1.csv, caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx, staging_instructions.md, signed_manifest_docusign, kms_residency_table.csv, SOC2-summary.pdf
>
Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Sr. Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor manifest + staging plan for SIG3 review

Sofia / team — this plan looks good, thank you. A few clarifications before we proceed to procurement sign-off:

1) Pre-signed URL approach is acceptable. Please ensure each artifact includes an explicit SHA256 checksum in the manifest and provide a signed checksums file for audit.
2) KMS residency: we need the table to show separation of duties (who administrates keys), and whether keys are HSM-backed. If you support BYOK for evidence bundles, note the steps and any limitations.
3) For the signed manifest: please use the DocuSign link and set the signing order to: Redwood signatory -> Novus procurement. I'll be the final approver on Novus side. Please send the DocuSign with the manifest PDF plus a one-paragraph attestation.

Attachments: procurement_checklist.pdf (internal) — I'll send the IAM role ARN in a follow-up if we later prefer role-based access. For now, presigned upload is preferred.

DocuSign link you mentioned (please populate): https://docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF123456

If you can get the initial package by Jun 17 that's ideal; procurement will accept the DocuSigned manifest by Jun 20.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Elaine
Elaine Park
